name: security-audit-kit
description: Judgment layer for a pinned, local security scan: triage scanner findings real-vs-false-positive with an evidence bar, semantic SAST (authz/IDOR/logic), AI/LLM security review, STRIDE threat modeling, and a one-command audit. The skills drive the repo's own vendored, pinned scanner (tools/security-audit-kit/scan.sh); the plugin never downloads one.
